name: Glute Kickback Machine
how_to:
Glute Kickback Machine Benefits
- The primary muscle that the Glute Kickback Machine engages is the Gluteus Maximus. It is one of the exercises you can include in your workouts to tighten and tone the glutes, improve hip mobility, and strengthen your lower back.
